changelog: The job number can be typed over straight from the Orders list. Click it, type the number that is written on the slip, press Enter or tab away — it is saved on the spot. Escape puts the old one back. It still has to stay unique: a number already on another order is refused and the old one is kept.

Nobody is given a design job by the system any more. A new job stays with no designer against it until a person takes it off the board or someone names him by hand, so a name never appears on work that was never accepted. The round-robin auto-assign setting is gone from Settings along with the code behind it.
In the item box the designer now reads "— Nobody yet —" instead of "Assign later / auto", because nothing is assigned automatically any more.
